title: Words (string)
instructions: std::string holds text, like a name. It needs #include <string>.
+ glues two pieces of text together: "Hi " + name.
name.size() tells you how many letters it has.
task: Make the program print:  Hello, Sam! Your name has 3 letters.
hint:
Print the pieces one after another:

    std::cout << greeting << " Your name has " << name.size() << " letters.\n";
expected_output: Hello, Sam! Your name has 3 letters.
